scopeUse: Product and outcome inventory only; original questions, prose and independent appraisal labels. This is not WSET's tasting form, assignment or grading.
integrationResponsibility: Root integrates into canonical new release, routes exact selectors, validates actual practice and preservation. This agent has not edited Git, CI, Android, existing files or canonical manifest.
sourcePolicy: Reuse existing canonical source IDs and URLs. Every new item cites primary product/method evidence or university research-method teaching. Original scenarios clearly supply their own hypothetical observations, agronomic records, budgets, timings and demand; cited sources do not validate those premises. New items assert no numeric regulatory rule. Source pages' promotional superiority or numerical errors were not adopted.
